# Marina Development Plot 4E

> Plot 4E forms part of the Dubai Marina development, the waterfront district built around an artificial canal cut inland from the Gulf coast between Sheikh Zayed Road and Jumeirah Beach Residence. The masterplan sets residential and mixed-use towers around the marina itself, with a waterside promenade and podium-level retail running through the district. Plot 4E is one of the individually numbered development parcels within that grid.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Marina, UAE
- Status: Completed
